sessions.lastUserText: Does other model do that like 5.6?

last.text:
**GPT-5.6 doesn’t accept audio directly**, according to its [published specs](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-sol).

**Other models do:** [GPT-Transcribe](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-transcribe) takes audio and outputs text, including multilingual speech with language switching.

For your Cantonese–English video, the workflow is: **audio → GPT-Transcribe → transcript → Astra or 5.6 for translation into your chosen languages.**

last.text:
Yes. Staging and production accounts are separate because they live in separate databases.

- **FiftyStrong Staging** uses staging accounts.
- **FiftyStrong** uses production accounts.

The same email can exist in both, but its subscription, workouts, and progress are independent. Creating an account in one doesn’t create it in the other.
